subject: Dedicated capacity: GPU mix & $/1M tokens target (post-demo)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@helix.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:15:00Z
Subject: Dedicated capacity: GPU mix & $/1M tokens target (post-demo)

Thanks again for the demo this morning — appreciated the context on inference patterns and the latency SLOs. Quick recap and three asks so we can move pricing/pilot paperwork forward:

Recap (Helix.ai requirements)
- Expected sustained volume: ~500M tokens / month (burst to ~20M tokens/day during peak).
- Typical request size: 400-1,200 tokens; p95 latency target ~<300ms for 1k tokens.
- Desired unit anchor: target $/1M tokens to evaluate economics vs. building in-house.
- Preferred GPU: H100 for quantized 8-bit workflow, but budget team asked to see A100 band as a lower-cost alternate.

Asks
1) Can you confirm the 500M/month volume (or provide a 3-tier forecast: conservative/expected/peak) by end of day tomorrow?
2) What monthly budget range does procurement have for this project (ballpark is fine: e.g., <$50k, $50-100k, >$100k)?
3) Are you ok with a 6-week pilot on reserved A100 capacity if we can hit an equivalent $/1M token anchor within your budget?

Next steps from our side: Ben will share a concise SKU matrix with H100 vs A100 reserved lanes and an equivalent $/1M token conversion so you can show procurement the unit economics. I’ll also attach a pilot PO template and SOC2 evidence list for procurement to review.

Thanks — CCing Ben and Aditya to action the pricing anchor.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sku-matrix-v1.pdf (pricing anchor), helix-pilot-po-template.docx (pilot PO template), soc2-evidence-list.xlsx (compliance checklist)

From: Sam Patel <sam@helix.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Helix.ai Procurement <procurement@helix.ai>
Date: 2027-06-30T12:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: GPU mix & $/1M tokens target (post-demo)

Thanks Camila — great session. Quick answers inline:

- Volume: we ran a 30-day pilot last quarter; extrapolating, conservative = 300M/mo, expected = 500M/mo, peak = 800M/mo (these include some internal LLM usage plus customer-facing features).
- Budget: procurement gave a soft range of $60k–$120k/month for committed capacity for Q3, with a preference to land closer to the low end.
- Pilot: procurement prefers to avoid H100 for an initial pilot due to sticker shock; they asked if we can start on A100 lanes and prove unit economics, with option to upgrade to H100 for production if latency/quality delta warrants it.

Can Ben please convert those volumes to an equivalent $/1M tokens across the H100/A100 options? Also we need a short note on expected throughput (tokens/sec) that each reserved lane will support so our infra team can map to in-house network and peering.

Sam
Sam Patel
Head of AI Platform, Helix.ai
sam@helix.ai | +1 (650) 555-0219

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@helix.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: GPU mix & $/1M tokens target (post-demo)

Sam — thanks. Attached is the SKU matrix (redwood-dedicated-sku-matrix-v1.pdf) and below is a concise anchor you can share with procurement. I used the expected volume (500M/mo) for the examples and included conservative/peak columns in the PDF.

Pricing / unit-econ anchors (equivalents shown are normalized to $ per 1M tokens)
- H100 (4x reserved H100 lane) — Estimated monthly commit: $95,000 — Equivalent unit: ~$19 / 1M tokens (500M/mo basis).
- A100 (8x reserved A100 lane) — Estimated monthly commit: $68,000 — Equivalent unit: ~$27 / 1M tokens (500M/mo basis).
- A100 (6x reserved A100 lane, higher batching) — $54,000 — Equivalent unit: ~$36 / 1M tokens (fits lower budget but constrains peak headroom).

Throughput estimates (approximate sustained token throughput per reserved lane)
- 1x H100 reserved lane: sustained ~3.5M tokens/hour (~972 tokens/sec) for mixed prompt sizes; burst to ~6M tokens/hour with autoscaling.
- 1x A100 reserved lane: sustained ~1.8M tokens/hour (~500 tokens/sec); burst to ~3.2M tokens/hour with batch tuning.

Operational notes
- The H100 anchor gives better headroom for peak bursts (reduces risk of throttling during product-driven spikes).
- The A100 options are a good cost-first pilot path; we recommend sizing A100 pilot to the 6x lane option to stay inside the $60k–$70k bracket and run for 6 weeks to validate real-world unit economics.

If that looks reasonable I’ll open a pilot quote (incl. SOC2 evidence + pilot SLA) and a short procurement checklist for PO submission.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: redwood-dedicated-sku-matrix-v1.pdf

From: Sam Patel <sam@helix.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Helix.ai Procurement <procurement@helix.ai>
Date: 2027-07-01T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: GPU mix & $/1M tokens target (post-demo)

Thanks Ben and Camila — that framing helps a lot. Procurement signaled they can approve a 6-week pilot on the 6x A100 lane at ~$54k/mo equivalent (pilot discounted pro-rata). Two quick asks from our side to pull the PO: 1) a one-page pilot SOW we can attach to the PO, and 2) a confirmed DocuSign link for the pilot quote so procurement can route quickly.

If the pilot proves out unit economics we’ll fast-track a follow-on production commit on H100 lanes — I’ll also introduce our infra lead to map the throughput numbers to peering/network config.

Please send the SOW and DocuSign link and I’ll loop procurement to cut the PO.

Best,
Sam
